title: a master material with parameters, an instance that overrides them, compiled and applied
proves: author a material graph, instance it, read the parameter values back, and see it on a mesh

steps.label: primitive puerts_material_build is registered
1. author the amber emissive master material the prompt asked for
1. the master material compiled
1. the master material was saved after its read-back agreed
primitive puerts_material_inspect is registered
1. read the master back with the independent material inspector
1. the inspector identifies the parent as a material
1. every parameter the prompt asked for is published by the parent
1. the inspector reports a structure hash for the master
primitive puerts_material_instance_build is registered
2. build the material instance with the prompt's parameter values
3. read the instance back and compare the overrides field for field
3. the inspector identifies it as an instance
3. the scalar override is the one the prompt asked for
3. the vector override is the colour the prompt asked for
3. the instance names the master this slice authored
3b. rerunning the identical master spec converges
3b. re-read the master after the rerun
3b. the master's structure hash is unmoved by an identical rebuild
3b. a converged rerun of the master wrote no new bytes to disk
primitive puerts_texture_import is registered
primitive puerts_blueprint_build is registered
4. put the instance on a mesh through a component template property
primitive puerts_viewport_screenshot is registered
5. capture the viewport so the material can be judged by eye
6. shader compilation is not observable
steps.detail: no registered tool reports whether the shader compiler has finished, so a screenshot taken immediately after a material change can legitimately show the default checkerboard. Lane I reports compile result inside the instance build response, which covers the instance but not the shader map.
